summary: A small app that posts one daily notification reminding the user to drink water at a time the user chooses, with the reminder able to be turned on or off and the settings kept on the device across restarts.
targetUsers: People who want a daily nudge to drink water
Users who prefer a single configurable daily reminder rather than frequent alerts
goals: Post a daily water-drinking reminder at the user's chosen time
Let the user set the reminder time and turn the reminder on or off
Keep the reminder settings on the device and restore them after restart
nonGoals: Tracking how much water the user drinks
Syncing settings across devices or accounts

features.name: Daily water reminder
features.userOutcome: The user receives one notification each day at the chosen time telling them to drink water.
features.trigger: The chosen reminder time arrives while the reminder is on.
features.behavior: The app posts a notification titled "Drink Reminder" with the body "Time to drink some water." at the reminder time stored in the reminder settings, at most once per local day; it records the local day it last sent in its own settings so it does not send twice on the same day. When the reminder is off, no notification is posted.
features.failureOutcome: If the notification cannot be posted, the app keeps the reminder settings unchanged and tries again at the next daily reminder time.
acceptanceSignals: With the reminder on and the time set to 09:00, a notification titled "Drink Reminder" with the body "Time to drink some water." is requested at or after 09:00 local time.
After a notification is sent for a local day, no further notification is requested for that same local day.
With the reminder off, no notification is requested at the stored reminder time.

features.name: Reminder settings
features.userOutcome: The user sets the daily reminder time and turns the reminder on or off, and those settings are still in place after restarting the app.
features.trigger: The user opens the app and changes the reminder time or the on/off switch.
features.behavior: The main screen shows a time field labeled "Reminder time" and a switch labeled "Reminder on". The time field starts at 09:00 and the switch starts on. Changing the time stores the new time; toggling the switch stores the new on or off state. Both values are saved on the device and loaded when the app starts again.
features.failureOutcome: If a setting cannot be saved, the app keeps the previously stored value and shows the field problem next to the control.
acceptanceSignals: On first launch the "Reminder time" field shows 09:00 and the "Reminder on" switch is on.
After the user sets "Reminder time" to 18:30 and restarts the app, the field shows 18:30.
After the user turns "Reminder on" off and restarts the app, the switch is off.

dataObjects.name: Reminder settings
dataObjects.purpose: Stores the user's chosen daily reminder time, whether the reminder is on, and the last local day a reminder was sent.
dataObjects.retentionIntent: Kept on the device for as long as the app is installed so the reminder survives restarts.

qualityRequirements: The reminder settings are restored exactly as saved after the app restarts.
The daily reminder is posted at most once per local day.
productConstraints: Only one reminder time is configurable.
The reminder notification text is fixed and not user-editable.
